content: For my master thesis “Multimodal collection of biometric data related to stress in XR interventions” I developed a reusable framework to facilitate the collection of ECG, head movement and voice recordings in standalone VR applications. Additionally, I implemented a version of the Stroop Room, a 360° adaptation of the Stroop color–word test, and collected participant data during the experience to evaluate my framework.
title: Framework for collecting biometric data in VR devices

content: Historia Virtualis is a colocated experience for 3 players set in the ancient Roman version of St. Pölten called Aelium Cetium. Every player has a specific tool in game which describes their role. An axe, flint and steel, and a peel. As each tool offers different abilities to the player using it they have to cooperate to achieve the goal of baking bread for the local governor.
title: Historia Virtualis

content: Pythagoras is a sci-fi first-person puzzle game set aboard the Pythagoras research station. As a new scientist on board, you use clues from your environment, and your knowledge of trigonometry, to build triangles out of everyday objects and operate the station’s advanced devices to keep its failing experiments running. It blends the challenge of a puzzle game with the exploration of an immersive sim, all wrapped in a retro-futuristic, low-poly aesthetic spread across four distinct biomes.
title: Pythagoras

content: Relaxing Garden is a mixed-reality biofeedback experience built at the SensAI Hack 2025 in Barcelona. Instead of charts and numbers, it turns your heart rate and heart rate variability into a garden that grows as you relax and slows when your arousal rises.
title: Relaxing Garden

content: Cthulhu’s organ is an underwater VR level created for a 360° Audio & Video course. It is built around sound: the instrument you play is a sampled church organ, and the entire mix is interactive and ambisonic, placing the organ, the sea creatures and Cthulhu around you in 3D space.
title: Cthulhu's organ

content: Sandcastle TD is a tactical sandbox tower defense game in which players build and defend a sandcastle against waves of beach critters using a roster of toy defenders. I contributed as a freelancer for Bling Bling Games, focusing on the systems behind the units and enemies as well as the build pipeline that kept the team shipping.
title: Sandcastle TD
